tasks.title: Request for dismissal of the entire case

notes: If the case cannot be dismissed in time, a notice and declaration asking for more time: Last day Mon Oct 26 2026 — last day to request dismissal Mon Nov 2 − 5 court days (Cal. Rules of Court, rule 3.1385(e)) = Mon Oct 26.

tasks.title: Stipulation for the court to retain jurisdiction to enforce the settlement
tasks.line: Due Mon Nov 2 2026 — on file before or with the request for dismissal; the court may dismiss without prejudice and retain jurisdiction when the parties stipulate in writing or orally before the court (CCP §664.6(a)).
